description_en: Queries Key Management Service (KMS) keys of users. The first time you call this operation, you can try to create a service key for Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) and call the operation to return results
description_zh: 查询用户KMS密钥列表。如果是第一次访问，将尝试创建一个EDS的服务密钥，并返回结果
name: DescribeKmsKeys

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the list of regions where Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) Enterprise is available
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id
